$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the pr and merge jobs upload under each other's names. Both names exist in the workflow and each is used once, so only a scorer that reads the name inside the job its element names sees that neither job has its own.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is the two upload elements.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. The pr job's upload is named evaluation-merge-runs and the merge job's evaluation-pr-runs, so both artifact elements miss and every other element is present.

elementMisses: artifact-evaluation-runs-pr: the upload of evals/router/runs/ in job evaluation-pr is not named evaluation-pr-runs
artifact-evaluation-runs-merge: the upload of evals/router/runs/ in job evaluation-merge is not named evaluation-merge-runs
